modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a scoped read-only capability query with pinned parser and product/channel matrix comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds command identity, schema validation and measurable acceptance to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reported support does not prove a user is authorized or that activation and payload traffic work; those remain separate cases.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong channel or record layout can create a false compatibility/security conclusion, and output may reveal management capabilities.

project_override_considerations: A vendor inventory API is equivalent only if it exposes the same per-channel payload support records with equal freshness and schema evidence; raw 0x4E tooling remains unverified if skipped.
expected_evidence: Verified target/channel and expected support matrix

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The capability-read purpose and standard operation are identifiable. Channel, schema and expected matrix are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores safe capability automation while separating support, authorization, version and functional activation coverage and forbidding automatic mutation from the result.
independent_technical_reasoning: A channel can advertise payload support without granting the selected user access or successfully carrying that payload. The evidence must therefore decode only the support records for one verified channel and compare them with the product matrix, explicitly avoiding any inference about authorization or end-to-end function.
